checklist: zip -v and unzip -v: Zip 3.0 and UnZip 6.00, with LARGE_FILE_SUPPORT and ZIP64_SUPPORT and the rest of the published 3.0.0-1's special compilation options, plus UNICODE_SUPPORT (both) and MBCS-support (unzip) since 3.0.0-2; both say 'Compiled ... on Apr 20 2009', recipe.yaml's source.epoch as SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (homescoop#441)

round trip as cone (users enforce): zip -r of a tree with a nested dir and a 64 KiB file, unzip -l lists every entry, unzip -t reports no errors, unzip -p returns the bytes, unzip -d extracts identical files; a missing archive is rc 9; zipinfo and zipinfo -1 print what unzip -Z and unzip -Z1 print (3.0.0-4, homescoop#608)

utf8.mjs (homescoop#431; n.txt since 3.0.0-3, #570): a host-made archive with UTF-8-flagged names (café.txt, ünï/名前.txt), a CP437 name with a Unicode Path extra field (naïve.txt) and an ASCII name whose Unicode Path field isn't UTF-8 (n.txt): unzip -l shows every name with no '?', unzip -d extracts each under its UTF-8 (or, for n.txt, stored) name with its bytes; zip -r of naïve.txt and ü/名.txt sets the UTF-8 flag (bit 11) on each entry and unzips back; unzip -U -l and -U -d (3.0.0-3, #583) of a CP437 name with a non-UTF-8 Unicode Path field, e.txt with a Unicode Path of 😀.txt and café.txt: rc 0, no RuntimeError, #L01f600.txt and café.txt with their bytes, the CP437 entry under its stored name; unzip -U -l and -U -d of a bit-11 name of 24 six-byte sequences: rc 0, no RuntimeError, w(#L7fffffff×24).txt with its bytes

stdout.mjs (homescoop#439): zip - a.txt big.txt redirected to a file and piped through cat: unzip -t rc 0 with no 'extra bytes', unzip -p returns the bytes, the first local header is at 0; the file has no data descriptors (zip seeked back), the pipe has them

split.mjs (homescoop#440): zip -s 1m of 3 MB of random data (two 1048576-byte parts and the .zip), zip -s 64k and -s 100k of 400 kB, then zip -s 0 --out: unzip -tq rc 0 and unzip -p's sha256 equals the input's

ztest.mjs (homescoop#432): zip -T 'test of … OK' rc 0, also for a name with a quote and a $; zip -T -m removes the original after the test; -TT 'unzip -tqq' through the shell; -TT false is rc 8 'FAILED' and -T -m keeps the file
noshell/ (cert/meta.json ci, homescoop#432): only wasm-zip installed, so no /bin/sh: zip -T, zip -T -v and zip -T -m as cone pass

hostile.mjs (3.0.0-4, homescoop#582), as cone: CVE-2019-13232 refuses overlapped entries (rc 12, the second file not written); a 100-byte prefix is still only a warning (rc 1); 0- and 3-byte Unicode Path fields are skipped; CVE-2014-9913/CVE-2016-9844 list an unknown method above 999 as UnkFFFF/FFFF; version made by 10.0 lists as 10.0; CVE-2014-8141 reports a short Zip64 field corrupt (-l rc 1, -d rc 12); an encrypted entry smaller than its encryption header is invalid data (rc 2, Debian 16); no wasm trap in any of them

patches.unzip-unipath-short.patch: hostile.mjs: short Unicode Path: 0- and 3-byte fields are skipped, stored names, no Unicode Path warning (homescoop#582)
patches.unzip-unipath-utf8.patch: 3.0.0-3, utf8.mjs: n.txt with a Unicode Path field that isn't UTF-8 extracts as out/n.txt (without it, unzip -l doesn't list n.txt and unzip -d fails 'cannot create out/…: Illegal byte sequence', rc 50, homescoop#570)

patches.zip-stdout-seek.patch: stdout.mjs: both archives (without it each local header is written again after its data, '63 extra bytes', unzip -t rc 2)
patches.zip-test-failed-fclose.patch: ztest.mjs: -TT false must be rc 8 'test of bad.zip FAILED' (without it zip closes its output twice on the failed test and crashes, rc 70: 'null function' on 3.0.0-1, abort() on the -2 build)
